role.description: System role determining permissions and privileges

RolePrivilege.description: Privileges configuration assigned to user or role

canManageFinances.description: Can record payments and view ledgers

canManageTransport.description: Can update bus routes and fleet

/fee_ledgers/{ledgerId}.description: Tuition fees, payments, balances, and receipt logs

/exam_preps/{prepId}.description: National exam preparation records (NPSE, BECE, WASSCE)

/system_settings/{settingId}.description: Institutional configuration, academic year, and term schedules
